pages.text: Engravable gems are cut from ordinary materials: arrange five of a kind in a plus. Diamond, redstone, lapis, emerald, quartz, amethyst shards, prismarine shards, glowstone dust, copper and ender pearls all work.$(br2)Each material accepts only certain patterns — check $(l:socket-sorcery:gems/compatibility)Compatibility$(/l).
Every engravable gem follows the same shape.
